title: The Mouse and the Frog
summary: A malicious frog tied a mouse's leg to his own, dragging the mouse into deep water to drown him. A kite soaring above saw the floating mouse, swooped down, seized the mouse, and ca...
full_text: A malicious frog tied a mouse's leg to his own, dragging the mouse into deep water to drown him. A kite soaring above saw the floating mouse, swooped down, seized the mouse, and carried off the tied frog into the bargain.
moral: He who ties a friend to a destructive scheme perishes in the same net.
